integrity: Proof derives derivative and sharp endpoints analytically; standalone finite checks are supporting evidence rather than proof. Prior general width-moment formula is credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact Haar-direction moments only; fixed positive area and perimeter; not a finite-sample estimator; inverse side-product stability degenerates as normalized area tends to zero; independent priority/audit unavailable.
title: Area-calibrated width-moment tomography of parallelograms, with sharp inverse slope
